visual_elements: Although the women of America are one step nearer to nylon stockings as a result of new ceiling price schedules . . . , the prospect of “nylons for Christmas,” except for a favored few, is not good, hosiery manufacturers said yesterday. —“Outlook Is Gloomy for Christmas Nylons,” New York Times, November 10, 1945
